Contributed to Test Automation efforts by converting manual API checks into runnable collections triggered from CI, improving API validation coverage for release candidates.

Designed and implemented Selenium-based Java automation frameworks for the web learning platform, covering course enrollment, assessments, and grading workflows. Developed Postman collections for backend API validation and smoke checks, and incorporated Linux-based runners to execute distributed Test Automation jobs. Identified and documented intermittent UI and API defects that improved platform stability and decreased customer-reported issues.
